author: Liqe
body:
Hello Legendary Engram,

It's me Whacka_ . I believe it has been a month since we last talked and I remember vividly you saying leave time to heal the wounds. Only you can call the shots if it has been enough time but please take into consideration I have deleted my hacking client and hope  to never  see of it again. Please unban if you would.


Kind Regards,

Whacka_
